FN-FGZN55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 335
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/24/2023
Senate Bill 335 as introduced would increase the financial obligations of the Alabama Board of
Examiners in Counseling by a board estimated $100,000 to establish the Alabama Licensed
Counselor Wellness Committee consisting of not less than 3, nor more than 9 licensee members
to provide for the operation of the Alabama Licensed Counselor Wellness Program created by
the provisions of this bill to develop, maintain and make available treatment programs for all
licensees who voluntarily seek medical intervention treatment and rehabilitation for an
impairment.

FN-FGZN55-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 335
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/30/2023
Senate Bill 335 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Alabama Board of
Examiners in Counseling by a board-estimated $100,000 to establish the Alabama Licensed
Counselor Wellness Program, directed by the Alabama Licensed Counselor Wellness
Committee established by this bill, to develop, maintain and make available certain intervention
treatment and rehabilitation programs to licensed counselors.
